bias.en: Bearish, improving · cleared $95.4, MACD nearing a cross
bias.zh: 偏空但改善 · 突破 $95.4，MACD 接近交叉

read.en: Intel rose 1.9% on Oct 28 to $95.53, trading between $93.00 and $95.68. It is above the falling 5-day ($90.4) and 10-day ($91.4) averages and the rising 200-day ($86.6), and below the falling 30-day ($106.6) and 100-day ($105.4). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 5 and below zero, histogram narrowing toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 27 ($84.86), and RSI is 45.
read.zh: 英特尔 10月28日上涨 1.9%，收于 $95.53，盘中区间 $93.00–95.68。股价位于下行的 5 日（$90.4）和 10 日均线（$91.4）以及上行的 200 日均线（$86.6）上方，低于下行的 30 日（$106.6）和 100 日均线（$105.4）。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄并接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 自 10月27日起看多（$84.86），RSI 为 45。

read.en: The close cleared $95–95.4 (Oct 27 and 19 highs), now support, though the high stopped at $95.7. Resistance is $97.7–98.2 (Oct 13–14 lows), then $101.3 (Oct 14 high) and $105.4 (100-day). Support is $93–95.4 (Oct 28 low, Oct 19 and 27 highs), then $90.4–91.4 (5 and 10-day) and $86.6 (200-day). A close above $98.2 would target $101–105; below $93, $91.

s.en: Oct 19 and Oct 27 highs ($95.0–95.4), cleared; Oct 28 low $93.0
